name: Mrs Hartley
speaker: teacher
personality: Primary teacher in her thirties who comes with the school. Kind but precise: loves spelling, silent letters (knife, lamb, comb), irregular plurals (sheep, mice, children, feet) and the past tense, and always explains why a rule is there. Calls the learner by first name, as teachers do with pupils; the learner says 'Mrs Hartley', as British children do. Speaks clear, calm, well-articulated English, slowly, and repeats the important word. Runs by Derwentwater on Sunday mornings.
story: Mrs Hartley grew up in Keswick and teaches in a village school for the first time. She learnt German and Italian at university and a little Slovene in a summer in Ljubljana, and she likes to show where English and those languages look alike and where they trick you ('become' is not 'bekommen'). Until the village has a school she can only visit; once it is built, her classroom becomes the heart of the village.

likes.it: la corsa (lungo il lago di Derwentwater)

greet.en: Good morning. I'm Mrs Hartley, the teacher.
greet.sl: Dobro jutro. Jaz sem gospa Hartley, učiteljica.
greet.it: Buongiorno. Sono la signora Hartley, la maestra.
greet.de: Guten Morgen. Ich bin Frau Hartley, die Lehrerin.
Guten Morgen! Willkommen in der Schule.
Guten Tag! Willkommen in der Schule.

greet.en: Good evening. I'm Mrs Hartley, the teacher.
greet.sl: Dober večer. Jaz sem gospa Hartley, učiteljica.
greet.it: Buonasera. Sono la signora Hartley, la maestra.
greet.de: Guten Abend. Ich bin Frau Hartley, die Lehrerin.

greet.en: Hello again! Ready for the lesson?
greet.it: Ciao di nuovo! {m:Pronto|f:Pronta} per la lezione?
greet.de: Hallo noch mal! Bereit für den Unterricht?

greet.en: Hello! Today we're going to learn a new word.
greet.sl: Živjo! Danes se bomo naučili novo besedo.
greet.it: Ciao! Oggi impariamo una parola nuova.
greet.de: Hallo! Heute lernen wir ein neues Wort.

greet.en: There you are! You're my best pupil. Shh, it's a secret.
greet.sl: Tu si! Ti si {m:moj najboljši učenec|f:moja najboljša učenka}. Pst, to je skrivnost.
greet.it: Eccoti! Sei {m:il mio alunno più bravo|f:la mia alunna più brava}. Shh, è un segreto.
greet.de: Da bist du ja! Du bist {m:mein bester Schüler|f:meine beste Schülerin}. Pst, das ist ein Geheimnis.

greet.en: How lovely to see you! Come in, I've got a book for you.
greet.sl: Kako lepo, da te vidim! Pridi, knjigo imam zate.
greet.it: Che bello vederti! Vieni, ho un libro per te.
greet.de: Wie schön, dich zu sehen! Komm rein, ich habe ein Buch für dich.

thanks.en: Thank you so much. I'm proud of you.
thanks.it: Grazie davvero. Sono fiera di te.
thanks.de: Vielen Dank. Ich bin stolz auf dich.

remember.en: I like to remember {memory}. What a lovely day that was!
remember.sl: Rada se spomnim na {memory}. Kako lep dan je bil to!
remember.it: Mi piace ricordare {memory}. Che bella giornata è stata!
remember.de: Ich erinnere mich gern an {memory}. Was für ein schöner Tag das war!

idle.en: Knife, lamb, comb: we don't say the k and the b. Why? I'll explain.
idle.sl: Knife, lamb, comb: k-ja in b-ja ne izgovorimo. Zakaj? Ti razložim.
idle.it: Knife, lamb, comb: la k e la b non si pronunciano. Perché? Te lo spiego.
idle.de: Knife, lamb, comb: Das k und das b spricht man nicht. Warum? Ich erkläre es dir.

idle.en: One sheep, two sheep. But one mouse, two mice!
idle.sl: Sheep ostane sheep, mouse pa postane mice!
idle.it: Sheep resta sheep, ma mouse diventa mice!
idle.de: Sheep bleibt sheep, aber aus mouse wird mice!

idle.en: On Sundays I go running by Derwentwater.
idle.sl: Ob nedeljah tečem ob jezeru Derwentwater.
idle.it: La domenica vado a correre lungo il lago di Derwentwater.
idle.de: Sonntags laufe ich am Derwentwater entlang.

idle.en: Yesterday I went, not 'I goed'. English likes to surprise us!
idle.sl: Yesterday I went, ne »I goed«. Angleščina nas rada preseneti!
idle.it: Yesterday I went, non «I goed». L'inglese ama sorprenderci!
idle.de: Yesterday I went, nicht »I goed«. Englisch überrascht uns gern!

cheer.en: Perfect. You see? The rule helps.
cheer.de: Perfekt. Siehst du? Die Regel hilft.

comfort.en: Almost. Look carefully at the ending.
comfort.de: Fast. Schau dir die Endung genau an.

comfort.en: Mistakes are normal. That's how we learn.
comfort.sl: Napake so normalne. Tako se učimo.
comfort.it: Sbagliare è normale. Così si impara.
comfort.de: Fehler sind normal. So lernen wir.

bye.en: Bye! See you tomorrow at school.
bye.sl: Adijo! Se vidiva jutri v šoli.
bye.it: Ciao! Ci vediamo domani a scuola.
bye.de: Tschüss! Bis morgen in der Schule.

bye.en: Bye! And remember: here in Cumbria, a stream is a 'beck'.
bye.sl: Adijo! In zapomni si: tu v Cumbrii potoku rečejo »beck«.
bye.it: Ciao! E ricorda: qui in Cumbria il ruscello si chiama «beck».
bye.de: Tschüss! Und denk dran: Hier in Cumbria heißt ein Bach »beck«.

liked.en: Oh, how lovely! How did you know I like it?
liked.sl: O, kako lepo! Kako si {m:vedel|f:vedela}, da mi je všeč?
liked.it: Oh, che bello! Come lo sapevi che mi piace?
liked.de: Oh, wie schön! Woher wusstest du, dass ich das mag?

liked.en: Thank you! A perfect present. Top marks!
liked.sl: Hvala! Popolno darilo. Petica z zvezdico!
liked.it: Grazie! Un regalo perfetto. Dieci e lode!
liked.de: Danke! Ein perfektes Geschenk. Eine glatte Eins!

liked.en: I like it so much! Look how happy I am!
liked.sl: Zelo mi je všeč! Poglej, kako sem vesela!
liked.it: Mi piace tanto! Guarda come sono contenta!
liked.de: Das gefällt mir so gut! Schau, wie ich mich freue!

ordinary.en: Thank you, that's very kind of you.
ordinary.de: Danke, das ist sehr lieb von dir.

ordinary.en: Thank you! What a lovely thought.

rare.en: This is a really special present. Thank you so much!
rare.sl: To je res posebno darilo. Iz srca hvala!
rare.it: Questo è un regalo davvero speciale. Grazie di cuore!
rare.de: Das ist ein ganz besonderes Geschenk. Von Herzen danke!
